text:
Maya Chen: Quick question — new hire started Jul 10, summer blackout Jul 15-19. They have a medical appointment Jul16 and only 8 hours PTO left. Can we prorate accrual and allow a 2-day carryover or convert to sick? Need manager + payroll steps.

Tom Lewis: We prorate accruals by start date. For medical carryover we need People Ops signoff + manager approval. Payroll cutoff is Jul 22.

Aisha Rahman: Im the hiring manager — I can approve conditionally. Could also shift from on-call budget if needed.

Maya Chen: Two asks: 1) Prefer convert to sick if doc note provided vs temporary carryover? 2) How to record approval so payroll sees it before cutoff?

hr-bot: See policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy (Accrual & Exceptions). Medical conversions require a note and BambooHR comment.

Jen Soto: Manager should add a BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops. Payroll watches for tag #PTO-EXCEPTION before cutoff. I can notify payroll.

Aisha Rahman: Added BambooHR comment: "Approve 2-day carryover Jul16-17 for medical; employee to submit note by Jul25."

Maya Chen: Please have employee email medical note to hr@redwood.com (secure folder). I filed exception INC-ptocarry-19680 and will add to PTO Exceptions - Jul.

Jen Soto: Flagged payroll to hold entries with #PTO-EXCEPTION until Jul22 COB.

Maya Chen: Once note received People Ops will mark days as carryover or convert to sick in system and confirm. Template for BambooHR comment: "Manager approval: Approve 2 days PTO carryover (Jul16-17) for medical; employee will submit medical note to HR inbox by Jul25. Manager: Aisha Rahman."

hr-bot: Policy reminder: if note not received by Jul25, carryover void and PTO must be used or paid out per policy.

Tom Lewis: Also please log in the monthly PTO exceptions sheet for finance forecasting.

Maya Chen: Done. Action items: employee sends note, manager comment present (done), People Ops review, payroll picks up before Jul22.

Jen Soto: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
_meta: Synthetic Slack thread about PTO accrual proration, medical carryover approval, BambooHR and payroll steps.
